name: General Perspective Transformation
aliases: Perspective Transformation with Eye and Projection Plane Off-Origin
definition: A perspective transformation where both the eye and the projection plane may be away from the origin. The eye is at (0, 0, e_o - z_t) and the projection plane is z = -z_t. This ensures the Jacobian is the identity at the center of the visibility bounding box (Vbb).
summary: General Perspective Transformation allows the eye and projection plane to be offset from the origin, preventing floating-point errors in screen-z values when rendering geometry far from the world origin.
